macros.name: rotcaption
macros.doc: Here we offer a suggestion for a \rotcaption command, which inserts the caption rotated by 90 degrees.

macros.name: rotFPbot
macros.doc: The skips, \rotFPtop and \rotFPbot, are initialized from the standard LaTeX (internal) \@fptop and \@fpbot skips. As a result, by default, rotated floats appear horizontally centered on their float pages.

macros.name: turnbox
macros.doc: A macro version of the ‘rotate’ environment.

envs.name: rotate
envs.doc: Rotate the contents of the environment, leaving no space.

envs.name: sideways
envs.doc: Environment to turn the contents through 90 degrees.

envs.name: sidewaysfigure
envs.doc: The environments sidewaystable and sidewaysfigure introduce landscape-form floating tables and figures, respectively. (Each of the environments has a “starred” version, such as sidewaystable*, for a single-column float in a double-column area of the document.)

envs.name: sidewaystable
envs.doc: The environments sidewaystable and sidewaysfigure introduce landscape-form floating tables and figures, respectively. (Each of the environments has a “starred” version, such as sidewaystable*, for a single-column float in a double-column area of the document.)
